title: Beginning afresh without a complete new plan

captions.physics: Using change for another shared leisure
captions.energy: Waiting for a fully arranged pleasure
captions.emotions: Meeting an unfamiliar option with openness

meaning: Curiosity supports leisure when changed plans leave room for a small free experiment without a complete programme for the evening.
text: A free turn sometimes appears before a ready plan. The Wheel of Fortune in the physical position of Svadhisthana helps change leisure with circumstances. The World in energy leans towards awaiting a complete programme of new enjoyment before beginning. The Fool in emotions allows openness to an unfamiliar option. Curiosity does not always need a whole script. Two people may simply try something pleasant and decide about continuation afterwards, without promising advance knowledge of its precise form and outcome. Experience itself can help the next choice become clearer.

For example, a closed passage changes your usual walk. Rather than devising an entire new route, you notice a small courtyard with an unusual mosaic and enter. **New pleasure can begin without a finished programme.** You can examine details, invent amusing names and choose the next turn afterwards. Free participation keeps the impression shared without turning it into a large plan explaining the whole remainder of the changed day.

The difficulty is halting every trial until its design is completed. You seek every option, compare them and move further from interest in what you noticed. Flexibility remains a possibility on a map. Openness supports leisure when incomplete knowledge is allowed. One small experience can guide continuation better than a detailed plan made without it, leaving future time free from a new obligation.
